messages:
Rohan Mehta: Tom from Novo raised INV-9342 — they saw a Dedicated overage during a planned failover test. Can billing confirm?
Tom Liu (Novo): Correct. We did a regional failover test 2026-05-10 10:20 UTC for ~22m. Invoice shows a DEDICATED_BURST line:
```
Period: 2026-05-10
ReservedCommit: 500,000 token-hours
BurstUsage: 820,000 token-hours
Charge: $5,760
```
We notified support but didn't get an explicit pre-authorization.
billing-bot: Alert: Dedicated burst threshold exceeded for account novo-prod at 2026-05-10T10:21:03Z — estimated charge $5,760
Maya Patel: policy recap: scheduled DR drills with advanced notice may be eligible for a one-time operational credit if we were notified >=24h ahead and AE or Support acknowledged. Did you get a ticket ID?
Tom Liu (Novo): Support ticket SUP-65222 created 2026-05-09 09:12 UTC (we attached the runbook). AE replied but not a formal authorization.
Priya Rao: action items: 1) pull per-node meters 2026-05-10 09:45-11:00 UTC; 2) check whether warmup/proxy amplification occurred; 3) verify SUP-65222 presence. Opening BILL-2026-1011.
Rohan Mehta: propose provisional credit 40% ($2,304) if meter logs match scheduled test and there's no abuse. Any objections?
Maya Patel: +1 provisional 40%. Also note: if proxies duplicated requests during warmup that's a technical cause we can jointly remediate with Solutions. Add a note to invoice: "Provisional operational credit pending final reconciliation."
Tom Liu (Novo): Appreciate it. We'll accept the provisional amount and can schedule a config review.
billing-bot: Attached export: /exports/novo/2026-05-10-usage.csv. Meter IDs: node-eu-primary,node-eu-proxy-1,node-usw-standby
Priya Rao: uploaded reconciliation draft to BILL-2026-1011. Early look shows proxy spikes: node-eu-proxy-1 reported repeated 200k token batches during 10:20-10:30 UTC. I'm mapping to invoice lines now. Recon ETA 36h.
Maya Patel: if recon confirms scheduled test + proxy amplification, apply provisional credit and schedule Solutions review. If recon shows multiple similar tests in last 30d, escalate to legal.
Rohan Mehta: will flag to AE and CS to coordinate the review. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
